verdict.rationale: Cline's agent runs terminal commands, reacts live to test/build output, and lets developers direct it via natural language to investigate and fix issues (e.g. screenshot-based bug reports), which covers the core of natural-language debugging/troubleshooting. However there is no dedicated 'debugging' feature, error-log-ingestion, or stack-trace-analysis tooling documented, and community evidence only broadly praises agentic coding rather than debugging specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated debugging/troubleshooting workflow documentation, evidence of log/stack-trace analysis features, and independent hands-on verification of debugging accuracy.
